prompts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: final 3x3 exercise-animation keyframe sheet, nine equal square cells in row-major chronological order, no gutters or text. Generate a NEW full-color realistic educational render of a muscular adult man performing a dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift (Romanian-style hip hinge with soft knees). Input 1 is a GEOMETRIC REFERENCE ONLY: follow its nine joint positions and EXACT invariant bone lengths, replacing the schematic with a realistic muscular human. Input 2 is the APPROVED CHARACTER/style/skin/clothes reference only. Input 3 shows the old move for context but has anatomy distortion at the bottom and must NOT guide body proportions.
Camera: strict fixed ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE PROFILE. Man faces RIGHT. Both feet stay planted at exactly the same screen coordinates, on two parallel hip-width tracks; far foot subtly visible a few pixels to the right. No zoom, camera motion, perspective/rotation change, reframing or body scale change anywhere. Full head, body, shoes and both dumbbells fit with margin in every square. Identical muscular tan shirtless adult man, dark short hair, charcoal gym shorts, black sneakers with white soles. Same high-quality realistic render style as reference 2, warm off-white studio background, neutral consistent lighting.
Nine increasing hip-hinge stages upright to bottom: torso angles from horizontal 90,82,74,66,58,49,41,33,25 degrees. Pelvis hinges backward smoothly; shoulders move diagonally forward/down. Lumbar spine is neutral/straight; head and neck continue torso line, never looking up when bent. Knees stay SOFT with about 15 degrees flexion THROUGHOUT, never squatting, never hyperextending. Crucially femur, tibia, torso, arm, foot lengths and muscular volumes are IDENTICAL in all cells. Tibias/femurs are rigid bones in a profile camera: no foreshortening excuse, NO lower leg growth, no shrinking thighs, no ballooning hips, no melting shorts. Use the joint reference as an invariant skeleton; retain a recognizable modest glute/hip outline rather than expanding it at bottom.
Both dumbbells have fixed black hex heads and the same size at all times; held at sides/front of legs with palms toward thighs, arms extended naturally with straight elbows. Weights track very close to the thighs/shins, stop around mid-shin, NEVER reach the floor. A controlled hip hinge with hips back, balance mid-foot, all soles planted. No squat motion, rounded back, stretched shoulders, extra limbs/weights, clipping, morphing skin/objects, shadows changing, labels, numbers, arrows, overlays, logos or watermark. Nine distinct stages of ONE descent, NOT a full cycle. Final sheet exactly 3x3 nine complete poses.

Use case: sketch-to-render. EDIT IMAGE 1 INTO A REALISTIC 3D-STYLE EXERCISE ILLUSTRATION SHEET. Keep the exact 3x3 layout, camera, joint positions and SAME bone lengths from this geometric pose guide. Replace ONLY the colored stick skeleton with a photorealistically shaded muscular adult human; add muscles and skin around the existing bones, not different proportions. Render the black blocks as two fixed-size black hex dumbbells, near and far at both sides of legs. Image2 is ONLY the approved man's skin, shorts and rendering-style reference. Do not copy image2's apparatus, pose or camera. No other references.
This is a dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift hip hinge, nine increasing descent stages in row-major order. Strict ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE VIEW, man faces RIGHT, camera locked. Same tan muscular shirtless man, short dark hair, charcoal shorts, black sneakers with white soles, warm off-white studio background.
Most important: Every femur EXACTLY80px, tibia EXACTLY80px, hip-to-shoulder EXACTLY110px, arm EXACTLY146px in this 418px-cell guide. Preserve these projected lengths. The hips MUST NOT GROW or inflate on descent, no long thigh at bottom. Knee flexion stays about15 degrees, and all soles stay fixed on floor. Follow the guide's ankle, knee, hip and shoulder landmarks strictly in every cell. Pelvis tilts with trunk but stays same volume. Realistic quads, hamstrings, calves/glutes, muscle volume held constant.
The ankle is at (190,376) in EVERY cell; feet don't slide. Knee coordinates of successive9cells approximately (204,297),(200,297),(196,296),(192,296),(189,296),(185,296),(181,296),(177,297),(173,298). Hip coordinates approximately (197,217),(190,217),(182,218),(174,219),(167,220),(159,221),(152,223),(145,225),(137,227). This establishes constant leg lengths and identical15degree soft knee flexion. NEVER replace this hip hinge with a squat. The torso rotates forward with a straight neutral spine around the moving hips. Neck follows torso; no looking up at bottom. Torso angles from horizontal90,82,74,66,58,49,41,33,25 degrees. Arms straight, hands/dumbbells track very close to legs; bottom dumbbells around MID-SHIN, clearly above floor. Maintain exact dumbbell size/count.
All nine full bodies and weights contained with margins. Same scale/position/lights/floor across cells. Finished realistic muscular color rendering, NOT schematic, no stick lines, colored skeleton, overlay, labels, numbers, captions, arrows or watermarks. Nine frames of ONE descent only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a3x3 nine-pose SIDE VIEW dumbbell hip hinge animation sheet. Correct ONLY the ARMS and DUMBBELL POSITIONS to keep anatomical arm length unchanged during descent. Do not redraw/repose the legs, feet, knees, hip, shorts, pelvis, torso, neck or head. Preserve all these body pixels, muscles and positions; preserve camera, scale,3x3 layout, backdrop, light and skin. The knees already have the desired constant soft bend and the feet must remain exactly fixed.
At the start, the man's shoulder-to-hand distance is about115pixels per418pixel square. Keep that SAME115px fully extended arm length (humerus+forearm) in ALL NINE POSES. His arms must NOT grow longer at the bottom. Both near and far elbows naturally straight, arms hang down from shoulders, each hand holding one rigid unchanged-size black hex dumbbell. Correct the later poses by shortening stretched humerus/forearm back to the ORIGINAL LENGTH, moving hands and dumbbells upward along the shins appropriately. For final pose shoulder approximately(218,151), hand should approximately(208,266), NOT(198,293). Final dumbbells should therefore be a little BELOW THE KNEES in the upper third of shin. This controlled hip hinge does not require reaching floor or mid-shin. All9poses must show exactly the same arm proportions, no extra elbows, fingers, weights or disconnected pieces. Weights stay very close to front/sides of legs.
Again, everything BELOW shoulders other than arms/hands/dumbbells is locked: leg/hip geometry, muscular size, shorts and stationary shoes never change, do not inflate hips or lengthen thighs. Same tan muscular man, same camera, same soft studio rendered style. Do not label anything, no overlay, numbers, caption, arrow or watermark. Keep nine distinct descending poses exactly as source.

notes: Bottom range is limited above the floor; soft knees and neutral hinge.
Manual visual landmarks are estimates, not motion-capture or clinical validation.
